const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Live controller for VLABench find_unseen_object, instance i00.
+
+The episode is controlled through rcb_client only.  This file is kept as the
+record of the commands and observation-driven decisions made in the session.
+"""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+layout = spec['proprio_layout']
+limits = np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['panda_joint_limits_rad'])
+
+
+def state(res):
+    p = np.asarray(res.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
+    return {k: float(v) for k, v in zip(layout, p)}
+
+
+def observe(tag, cameras=None, depth=True):
+    res = r.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video='none')
+    d = OUT / tag
+    d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    for name, image in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(image).save(d / f'{name}.png')
+    for name, arr in res.depth.items():
+        np.save(d / f'{name}_depth.npy', arr)
+    (d / 'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+    return res
+
+
+def command(q, fingers, seconds=1.0, tag=None, cameras=None):
+    q = np.clip(np.asarray(q, dtype=float), limits[:, 0], limits[:, 1])
+    a = np.r_[q, [fingers, fingers]]
+    n = max(1, round(seconds / .1))
+    res = r.submit('joint_position', np.tile(a, (n, 1)), dt=.1,
+                   interpolate='linear', cameras=cameras or ['forward'],
+                   video='none', note=tag or '')
+    if tag:
+        d = OUT / tag
+        d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+        for name, image in res.last.items():
+            Image.fromarray(image).save(d / f'{name}.png')
+        (d / 'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+    return res
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    observe('initial')
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

+def kinematic_model():
+    """Return reference pose and each revolute axis in world coordinates."""
+    data = np.load(OUT / 'calibration.npz')
+    P = data['proprio'].astype(float)
+    q0 = data['q0']
+    def pose(row):
+        quat = row[19:23]
+        return P_to_T(row[16:19], quat)
+    T0 = pose(P[0])
+    axes = []
+    points = []
+    for i in range(7):
+        row = P[5 + i*10]
+        Ti = pose(row)
+        relative = Ti @ np.linalg.inv(T0)
+        theta = row[i] - q0[i]
+        omega = Rotation.from_matrix(relative[:3, :3]).as_rotvec() / theta
+        omega /= np.linalg.norm(omega)
+        axis_point = np.linalg.pinv(np.eye(3)-relative[:3, :3]) @ relative[:3, 3]
+        axes.append(omega)
+        points.append(axis_point)
+    return q0, T0, np.array(axes), np.array(points)
+
+
+def P_to_T(position, quaternion_wxyz):
+    q = np.asarray(quaternion_wxyz)
+    T = np.eye(4)
+    T[:3, :3] = Rotation.from_quat(q[[1, 2, 3, 0]]).as_matrix()
+    T[:3, 3] = position
+    return T
+
+
+def fk(q, model):
+    q0, T0, axes, points = model
+    T = np.eye(4)
+    for i in range(7):
+        R = Rotation.from_rotvec(axes[i] * (q[i]-q0[i])).as_matrix()
+        A = np.eye(4)
+        A[:3, :3] = R
+        A[:3, 3] = (np.eye(3)-R) @ points[i]
+        T = T @ A
+    return T @ T0
+
+
+def ik(position, orientation, q_seed, model, position_weight=1.0,
+       orientation_weight=.2, regularization=.015):
+    goal_R = np.asarray(orientation)
+    q_seed = np.asarray(q_seed)
+    def error(q):
+        T = fk(q, model)
